description: This header defines internal socket structures and helper functions for POSIX socket operations within the Starboard platform, including socket address conversions, error translation, and socket option settings.

classes.name: SockAddr
classes.description: Helper class for converting between socket address structures and SbSocketAddress, supporting IPv4 and IPv6.

methods.name: FromSockaddr
methods.description: Initializes SockAddr from a sockaddr pointer.

methods.name: family
methods.description: Returns the address family (AF_INET or AF_INET6).
